scientific_integrity: Analytic proof through reversible spectral calculus and generator moment identities; packaged finite-matrix computations are corroboration only. Completeness of the older reliability literature cannot be assured.
scientific_limitations: Finite irreducible reversible chains, heterogeneous nonnegative killing, independent equilibrium redraws, fixed finite deadline and no time or monetary reset cost. The expansion is at fixed deadline and number of segments tending to infinity; nonreversible chains and fixed reset sites are not addressed.
title: Optimal equilibrium redraws and the first graph-sensitive capture correction
